meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 当容器代理出问题（如不回复、认证失败、挂载异常）时，Claude 会按这份手册排查：查日志、用 SQL 查询会话数据库、检查重复进程、修复挂载和心跳，并给出对应命令。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、容器失败、出现认证问题时，或你想了解容器系统怎么运作时，会触发这份排查指南。

say.text: 容器代理不回复了，帮我按排查步骤来。
帮我看看是不是有两个 nanoclaw 服务在运行。
say.note: 对应消息丢失的常见问题。

say.text: 查一下这个会话的 inbound.db 和 outbound.db。
say.note: 确认消息是否到达容器。

howto.what_en: When container agents misbehave (no reply, auth failure, mount issues), you get a troubleshooting manual: checking logs, querying session DBs with SQL, finding duplicate processes, fixing mounts and heartbeat, with commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when container agents aren't working, containers fail, there are auth problems, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: My container agent isn't replying; walk me through the debugging steps.
Check if two nanoclaw service instances are running.
Query the inbound and outbound DBs for this session.
say_en.note: Shows if messages reached the container.
